value.rationale: The natural object is a Gibbs choice map with bounded score spread and arbitrary prior weights. Formula (1) gives its exact perturbation budget in total variation, the parity threshold (3) identifies when a finite range loses any robustness improvement, and the PARTITION reduction shows exact saturation certification is computationally nontrivial for general priors. These are structural claims beyond a bare Jacobian rederivation; no application-level robustness improvement is asserted.
